name: RXC J1317.1-3821 (Hubble)
blurb: RXC J1317.1-3821, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: rxcj131713821-hubble
story: A massive cluster of galaxies studied as a natural lens telescope, whose gravity can magnify galaxies lying far behind it.

claims.text: RXC J1317.1-3821 is one of the most massive clusters in its survey and a lens candidate
Massive clusters like it serve as gravitational lens telescopes magnifying background galaxies
